script: What happened to every Rookie of the Year runner-up since 2016? In 2016, Karl-Anthony Towns won over Kristaps Porzingis. Porzingis eventually became an NBA champion. In 2017, Malcolm Brogdon won over Dario Saric. Probably the least star-studded matchup on this list. In 2018, was Ben Simmons over Donovan Mitchell. And career-wise, Mitchell has obviously aged much better. In 2019, was Luka Doncic over Trae Young. Luka, I would say, is easily the better player though. Both players became superstars. In 2020, was Ja Morant over Kendrick Nunn. And this one isn't even close long-term. Nunn only spent three seasons in the NBA, while Ja is already a perennial All-NBA player and an NBA champion. 2021 was LaMelo Ball over Anthony Edwards. And somehow five years later, they're now teammates in Minnesota. 2022 was Scottie Barnes over Evan Mobley, and just by fifteen voting points, Scottie won. Both players are good, and it's still just as close to this day on who was better. 2023 was Paolo Banchero over Jalen Williams. Jalen Dub has already become an All-NBA player and an NBA champion. 2024 was Victor Wembanyama over Chet Holmgren, two young centres who most recently faced off in the Western Conference Finals, who have been rivals since they both entered the NBA. 2025 was Stephon Castle over Zachary Risacher, with Castle getting ninety-two first-place votes, and most recently was Cooper Flagg beating Kon Knueppel in one of the closest Rookie of the Year races ever.
